name: ponytail
description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
one_liner: A free add-on that trains your AI coding assistant to reach for the simplest built-in solution instead of installing extra libraries and writing bloated code.
buyer: A startup CTO paying per-token for AI coding tools who is tired of the agent over-engineering simple features and driving up both cost and code review time.
business_use_cases: A small dev shop installs it so client deliverables come back leaner, cutting both AI usage costs and the hours spent trimming bloated PRs.
A solo indie hacker uses it to keep a side-project codebase small enough that they can still understand and maintain it solo.
A coding bootcamp uses it as a teaching aid to show students the difference between a native-browser solution and an unnecessary dependency.

money_ideas.idea: Publish a short paid guide ('Ship Smaller: 20 real before/after diffs') built from the benchmark examples, aimed at teams trying to cut AI coding costs.
Offer a code-review-as-a-service add-on that flags over-engineered PRs against this skill's rules for teams that don't want to self-host it.

steal_this: Turn the benchmark numbers (54% less code, 20% cheaper) into a shareable LinkedIn/X graphic comparing 'agent with vs without a minimalism skill' to drive installs.
